record: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault's map sidecars: an audio zone file and a static light file for each official map
dirtyTreeNote: Generated in the shared working tree, over uncommitted work by several sessions, including the whole mohaa profile and the Alice and F.A.K.K.2 sidecar pipelines this extends.

installation.root: E:/Games/Medal of Honor Allied Assault (1.00 US, laid down from the user's discs; see the contracts record)

format.source: code/qcommon/bsp_mohaa.h and the maps record; each size re-measured on the 54 maps

surfaceFlags.source: OpenMoHAA code/qcommon/surfaceflags.h (reference observation only), checked against the 54 retail maps' compiled shader records and pak shader scripts

compiledMaps.perFace: a shader's record recurs with different flags per use (textures/common/caulk with 77 surface flag values, 151 flag and content pairs): they are set per face

defaultRock.observation: shaders naming no material compile with rock: textures/central_europe/carpet_fancy1 (no shader script), textures/general_industrial/industrialgrate1 (surfaceparm fence only), textures/common/caulkshadow (nodraw castshadow nomarks nolightmap)
defaultRock.inference: 2015's compiler writes rock when a face names no material

examples: textures/misc_outside/subpen_water4 (rock over water contents, token water)

sphereLightLump.source: code/qcommon/bsp_mohaa.h, after OpenMoHAA's qcommon/qfiles.h mapspherel_t (reference observation only)
sphereLightLump.retailLimit: a map whose count reaches 1532 (MAX_MAP_SPHERE_L_SIZE) is refused [O]

sphereLightPower.rule: |intensity| * 7500 / d^2, a light under 5 left out (OpenMoHAA renderergl1/tr_sphere_shade.cpp RB_Sphere_AddLight)
sphereLightPower.negativeSpot: a spot with a negative radius by distance moves its origin across a disc of that radius and never passes the cone test in RB_Sphere_AddSpotLight
sphereLightPower.inference: MOHAA.exe is SafeDisc-encrypted; the law is OpenMoHAA's reading of 2015's renderer, which fnTech3's MoHAA light grid already takes (MOHAA_LIGHT_SCALE, tr_mohaa_world.c)

otherProfilesUnchanged.note: every other Ritual and RTCW profile's shipped zones regenerated with this compiler, byte-identical to pkg/
